# Operational Reports — Grafana

Network operational reports (Availability, Alarm, Asset, Event, Service). All dashboards query the `reporting` MySQL database live and are scoped by the **Global Collection** filter, mirroring the original `:All` / `:Group` report variants.

**Availability:** Device Availability · Outage Log  |  **Alarm:** Alarm Log · Top-N Most Common Alarms · Mean Time to Respond  |  **Asset:** Current Assets
